'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]], [[Israel's role in the Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Syria missile strikes (January 2021)]]
***An [[Israeli Air Force|Israel]]i [[airstrike]] in the city of [[Hama]], [[Syria]], destroys five [[Syrian military]] sites. According to [[Syrian Arab News Agency|SANA]], four people from the same family, including two children, are killed in the strikes. [https://www.dw.com/en/family-killed-in-israeli-airstrike-against-syria/a-56311220 (Deutsche Welle)]


;Business and economy
*The [[World Trade Organization]] rules that the [[United States]] violated the organization's rules when it significantly raised the [[tariff]] on some [[South Korea]]n goods, from 9.49% to 59.72%, in May 2016. [http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20210122000092 (''Korean Herald'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] reports a record 764 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/california/articles/2021-01-22/california-reports-record-daily-covid-19-death-toll-of-764 (U.S. News and World Report)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] reports 277 deaths in the past 24 hours, tying their previous state record set in August of last year. [https://www.news4jax.com/news/florida/2021/01/22/277-covid-19-deaths-in-florida-reported-friday-ties-state-record/ (WJXT-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[New Jersey]] reports their first two cases of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. Neither had travelled. [https://www.nj.com/coronavirus/2021/01/nj-reports-118-more-covid-deaths-3694-confirmed-cases-highly-contagious-uk-variant-found-in-state.html (NJ.com)]
****The [[United States]] surpasses 25 million cases of COVID-19, with about one in every 13 Americans testing positive for the virus. [https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/22/us/covid-coronavirus-25-million-cases.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belize]]
****The number of recoveries in [[Belize]] surpasses 11,000. [https://www.breakingbelizenews.com/2021/01/22/over-11000-belizeans-have-recovered-from-covid-19/ (Breaking Belize News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Cuba]] reports their first case of a variant from [[South Africa]] in an asymptomatic person who travelled from the country. [https://www.explica.co/cuba-confirms-that-it-detected-a-south-african-strain-of-covid-19-in-an-asymptomatic-traveler/ (Explica)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Panama]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Panama]] reports their first case of a variant from South Africa in a 40-year-old [[Zimbabwe]] native who entered the country from there. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-panama-idUSKBN29R2R1 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] surpasses 50,000 deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.dw.com/de/mehr-als-50000-corona-tote-in-deutschland/a-56308775 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/german-virus-death-toll-tops-50000-infections-sink-75420948 (ABC News)]
****Germany reports their first case of the more contagious [[Lineage B.1.1.248|B.1.1.248]] variant in a person who travelled from [[Brazil]] to [[Hesse]]. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-01-germany-case-brazilian-virus-variant.amp (MedicalXpress)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record of 234 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 9,920. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/326_DGS_boletim_20210122.pdf (DGS)]
****Portugal also reports their first case of the [[501.V2 variant]] that originated in [[South Africa]]. They do not indicate whether the individual travelled. [https://www.rtp.pt/noticias/pais/variante-da-africa-do-sul-identificada-em-portugal_n1291745 (RTP)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-portugal-south-africa/corrected-portugal-identifies-first-case-of-south-african-coronavirus-variant-idUSL8N2JX5BK (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Belgium]] declares a ban on non-essential travel in and out of the country from January 27 through March 1 in order to curb the spread of [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|SARS-CoV-2 variants]]. [https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/en/2021/01/22/non-essential-foreign-travel-to-be-banned-until-1-march/ (VRT)] [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210122-belgium-bans-non-essential-travel-to-curb-spread-of-covid-19-variants (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****A panel of scientists that advises the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Government of the United Kingdom|government]] announces that a variant first discovered in the [[United Kingdom]] is 30% more deadly than the original [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] [[virus]]. [https://fortune.com/2021/01/22/uk-virus-strain-more-lethal/ (''Forbes'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****For the first time since the beginning of the [[COVID-19 pandemic|pandemic]], [[Hong Kong]] will impose a [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in the [[Yau Tsim Mong District]] beginning this weekend. Negative [[COVID-19 testing]] results will be required in order to leave one's residence. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3118756/coronavirus-hong-kong-place-tens-thousands (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record 108 deaths in the past 24 hours. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2021/01/23/national/coronavirus-japan-deaths/ (''The Japan Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record of 18 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 660. [https://www.malaymail.com/news/malaysia/2021/01/22/covid-19-deaths-reach-new-peak-as-malaysia-adds-another-3631-cases/1943090 (''Malay Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Myanmar]]
****[[Myanmar]] receives its first 1.5 million doses of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] manufactured by the [[Serum Institute of India]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/myanmar-india-covid-19-vaccine-14020162 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Botswana]]
***[[Botswana]] surpasses 100 deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/others/botswanas-covid-19-deaths-surpass-10020210122124847 (ANI)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Pfizer]] says that they will supply 40 million doses of their [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] to lower- and middle-income countries. [https://www.businessinsider.com/pfizer-to-supply-40m-covid-19-shots-for-poor-countries-2021-1 (''Business Insider'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Nuclear disarmament]]
**The [[Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons]] enters into force, banning the development, testing, production, stockpiling, stationing, transfer, use and threat of use of [[nuclear weapon]]s in 51 countries. However, the world's major [[nuclear powers]] have not endorsed this international agreement. [https://www.voanews.com/usa/treaty-prohibition-nuclear-weapons-enters-force (Voice of America)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Cannabis in the United States]]
**[[Cannabis in Arizona]], [[2020 Arizona Proposition 207]]
***[[Arizona]] begins legal sales of recreational cannabis, making it the 15th state to do so. [https://apnews.com/article/arizona-phoenix-medical-marijuana-health-recreational-marijuana-95e630bac9a26a3c2e855eba101a7e2c (AP)]
*[[Social impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
**In [[Bnei Brak]], an [[ultra-Orthodox]] town near [[Tel Aviv]], ultra-Orthodox Jews attack an unmarked [[Israel Police|police]] vehicle while officers were inside it, causing a [[riot]] in which at least six people were arrested. [[Israel]] is currently in a lockdown. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3118862/ultra-orthodox-jews-attack-israeli-police-trigger-riot-over (''South China Morning Post'')]
*[[2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest|Indian farmers' protest]]
**Farmer leaders allege a conspiracy to kill four of them and create disturbance during their proposed tractor rally on [[Republic Day]] in [[Delhi]]. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/farm-leaders-allege-conspiracy-hatched-to-kill-4-of-them-in-tractor-rally-121012300011_1.html#:~:text=Protesting%20farmer%20leaders%20on%20Friday,tractor%20rally%20on%20January%2026.&text=Farmer%20leader%20Kulwant%20Singh%20Sandhu,against%20the%20three%20farm%20laws. (''Business Standard'')]
*[[Aftermath of the 2021 United States Capitol attack]]
**A [[United States magistrate judge|magistrate judge]] orders [[Oath Keepers]] member Donovan Crowl to be detained on charges for his role during the [[2021 United States Capitol attack|attack]] on the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-capitol-arrests-idUSKBN29R2C2 (Reuters)]
*[[Essex lorry deaths]]
**Seven culprits involved in the deaths of 39 [[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese]] [[unlawful immigration|unlawful immigrants]] smuggled in a [[Refrigerator truck|refrigerator lorry]] in [[Grays, Essex|Grays]], [[Essex]] in 2019 have been [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] on multiple counts of [[Manslaughter in English law|manslaughter]]. Five people received sentences of between 3 to 18 years in prison, while the two main leaders of the smuggling operation received 20 and 27 years respectively. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2021/jan/22/essex-lorry-deaths-two-ringleaders-jailed-total (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Corruption in Guinea#Corruption in the mining industry|Corruption in the mining industry of Guinea]]
**Israeli businessman [[Beny Steinmetz]] is sentenced by a [[Geneva]] court to five years in prison for corruption in obtaining [[Mining industry of Guinea|mining rights]] to an [[iron ore]] deposit in [[Guinea]], and is ordered to pay a fine of [[Swiss franc|CHF]] 50 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]56 million) to the [[canton of Geneva]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/diamond-magnate-gets-5-years-in-prison-in-swiss-corruption-trial-1.5278579 (AFP via CTV News)]
*Former [[Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina|Bosnian Army]] general and deputy Minister of Defense [[Sakib Mahmuljin]] is sentenced to ten years in prison for failing to prevent or punish foreign [[Islamist]] fighters who [[murder]]ed and [[torture]]d [[Serbs|Serbian]] prisoners during the [[Bosnian War]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bosnia-warcrimes/bosnian-muslim-ex-commander-jailed-10-years-over-war-crimes-by-islamist-fighters-idUSKBN29R1O6?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Law enforcement in Russia|Police in Russia]] arrest five aides of [[Alexei Navalny]] ahead of planned protests. Navalny has been under arrest since returning to [[Russia]] on January 17. [https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-restricts-internet-access-ahead-of-pro-opposition-alexei-navalny-protests/ (''Politico'')]
*[[Sam Gor]] [[drug lord]] [[Tse Chi Lop]] is arrested by [[Law enforcement in the Netherlands|police]] at [[Amsterdam Airport Schiphol]] in [[Amsterdam]]. The [[Australian Federal Police]] are seeking to extradite him to face trial. Twenty law enforcement agencies assisted the operation, known as "Operation Kungur". [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/asia-el-chapo-amsterdam-b1791852.html (''The Independent'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Cabinet of Joe Biden]]
**The [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] votes 93–2 to confirm [[Lloyd Austin]] as [[United States Secretary of Defense|Secretary of Defense]], making him the first [[African Americans|African-American]] to lead the [[United States Department of Defense|The Pentagon]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/jan/22/lloyd-austin-former-general-confirmed-biden-defense-secretary (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Mass media in Australia]]
**In response to a bill proposed by [[Parliament of Australia|parliament]] to require [[Dot-com company|dot-com companies]] to compensate local news outlets for hosting their content, [[Google]] threatens to block [[Australians]] from using its [[Google Search|web search engine]] should the current draft of the bill become [[Australian legal system|law]]. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2021/01/22/google-threatens-to-block-australians-over-media-law-.html (AFP via ''The Jakarta Post'')]
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] suspends an account linked to [[Iran]]'s [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] [[Ali Khamenei]] after Khamenei threatened to [[Murder|assassinate]] former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] in revenge for the [[assassination of Qasem Soleimani]] in 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-twitter-iran-suspension/twitter-suspends-account-of-iranian-supreme-leader-after-apparent-trump-threat-idUSKBN29R1WA (Reuters)]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**[[TikTok]] announces that they have banned [[Baked Alaska (livestreamer)|Baked Alaska]], the far-right activist who was arrested by the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] for participating in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|attack]] on the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/tiktok-ban-baked-alaska-youtube-1563783 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Alphabet Inc.]] announces that it will shut down its subsidiary [[Loon LLC|Loon]], which provides an aerial [[wireless network]] through [[high-altitude balloon]]s, saying that it is not "commercially viable". [https://www.barrons.com/news/alphabet-closes-down-internet-balloon-network-project-loon-01611315306?refsec=afp-news (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[British Athletics]] cancels its annual [[British Indoor Athletics Championships|indoor championships]] that were set to begin in [[Glasgow]] in February due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/30758245/british-athletics-cancels-2021-indoor-championships-due-covid-19 (ESPN)]
**Organisers of the [[Tour de Normandie]] cancel the annual seven-day bicycle race that was scheduled for May due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. This is the second year that it has been cancelled. [https://www.cyclingnews.com/news/organisers-cancel-tour-de-normandie-amid-covid-19-surge/ (Cycling News)]
**[[Real Madrid]] announces that their coach [[Zinedine Zidane]] has tested positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/real-madrid-coach-zinedine-zidane-tests-positive-for-covid-19/ (CBS Sports)]
